name: Honda Neneko
source:
An unfriendly girl who enjoys reading in the club room of the literary club, which is rarely visited by others.

Her parents' strict upbringing meant that she was forbidden access to common media and entertainment, so she has come to hide her otaku interests and even mock them instead.

As a result, with no friends to discuss her hobbies and unable to keep up with the discussions around her, she gradually became estranged from her class.

Doesn't have very good grades.
